requirements.name: AI / LLM Evaluation and Model Assurance
requirements.reason: Production runtime is deterministic Python/data-pipeline automation; no AI/ML/LLM/RAG/agentic model participates in lead decisions.

requirements.name: User Research, Problem Validation and UX Validation
requirements.reason: Current release is a non-interactive backend pipeline whose product output is a dated operational workbook; no end-user UX surface requires usability validation.

requirements.name: Product Analytics and Outcome Evidence
requirements.reason: Daily quota, funnel, country/category, health, incident and recovery metrics are instrumented with real production evidence; immutable pass verification follows merge.

requirements.name: Experimentation and Hypothesis Lifecycle
requirements.reason: No bounded experiment is currently required; adaptive routing is deterministic production control logic with tests/telemetry, not an active A/B or user experiment.

requirements.name: Progressive Delivery and Feature Safety
requirements.reason: Protected-main promotion, main-only production scheduling, serialized recovery, health guardrails and midnight stop behavior provide release safety; final pass follows merged evidence.

requirements.name: AI-Generated Engineering Quality and Maintainability Review
requirements.reason: A project-specific engineering review plus product/ANPOS CI evidence exists; final pass follows merged evidence.

requirements.name: Responsible AI and Human Oversight
requirements.reason: Lead Engine production does not use AI for user-facing/high-impact decisions; development-time ANPOS/assistant tooling is not runtime lead acceptance behavior.

requirements.name: Privacy, Regulatory and Compliance Evidence
requirements.reason: Publicly listed business contact data is processed across US/Canada sources by a Pakistan operator. Technical controls are documented, but qualified legal/privacy applicability review is intentionally not self-certified.
blocking_findings: Qualified privacy/compliance review remains required before jurisdiction-specific legal claims.

requirements.name: Architecture Decision Records
requirements.reason: Material legacy architecture choices are reconstructed into durable ADRs with repository evidence; final pass follows merged evidence.

requirements.name: AI Asset and Configuration Registry
requirements.reason: No AI model/prompt/retrieval/embedding configuration produces Lead Engine runtime behavior; development AI catalog remains unselected.

requirements.name: Compatibility, Deprecation and End-of-Life Management
requirements.reason: Runtime/package support and deprecation rules are recorded for Python, package, Actions and ANPOS protocol; final pass follows merged evidence.

requirements.name: Operational Runbooks and Resilience Drills
requirements.reason: Production recovery/runbooks are populated and tied to real quota-recovery, midnight-guard, Google capability and R2 recovery evidence.

requirements.name: Tamper-Evident Audit Journal
requirements.reason: SHA-256 chained privileged-action journal and verifier are implemented; pass follows merged CI verification.

requirements.name: Unified Risk and Exception Register
requirements.reason: Material operational, privacy/compliance, governance and coordination risks are registered with owners and mitigations; pass follows merged evidence.

rules: A passed state requires project-specific evidence and a verified repository/runtime reference.
not_applicable requires a non-empty project-specific reason.
A blueprint or policy file is never pass evidence.
Blocking findings must be cleared or explicitly risk-accepted through normal authenticated consent before release where policy permits.
Requirements 89-96 use the same evidence rule as Requirements 83-88: policy presence alone is never pass evidence.
Expired risk/compliance/decision evidence must be reconciled before relying on it for release or privileged automation.
